items.title: How Coinbase used Code Connect to guide agents and shrink token costs
items.excerpt: Coinbase's design systems team measured what Code Connect actually does for coding agents: 22.5% lower token cost and better design-to-code adherence, because agents stop hallucinating component and asset names.
items.rationale: First hard number on what design-system mapping buys in agent workflows — the system becomes a cost lever, not just a consistency lever.

items.title: Solidworks users spend “blue tokens” on AI drawings, insights and more
items.excerpt: Dassault Systèmes introduced a consumption-based "blue token" currency for AI usage across the 3DExperience platform, with each license carrying a free allocation and 25,000-token packs sold on top.
items.rationale: AI inside a core design tool stops being free — metered credits change how teams budget and ration AI in daily CAD work.

items.title: The call for an agentic standard: We need to stop shipping the same form four different times
items.excerpt: One description, four renderers: every assistant draws its own version of your UI, and the maintenance bill lands on the team that already owns the button component. MCP settled the plumbing; the rendering layer hasn't.
items.rationale: Names the next standards fight after MCP — who owns the rendered interface when four assistants each redraw your design system.

items.title: NVIDIA Finally Announces Launch Date For Its Controversial DLSS 5
items.excerpt: NVIDIA set a launch date for DLSS 5, the neural rendering update that artists have argued either preserves or destroys their original intent on screen.
items.rationale: Generative upscaling now sits between the artist's frame and the viewer's screen, with a date attached — a real-time craft question for anyone shipping 3D visuals.

items.title: Color scheming with Perplexity tetrads
items.excerpt: A case study in using generative AI to build accessible color palettes, working tetrad color relationships through Perplexity and checking them against contrast requirements.
items.rationale: A repeatable AI method for a foundational token decision — palette generation with accessibility checked, not assumed.

dedup.note: Checked every candidate by URL and by event/content against sections.design today (2026-09-02) plus days 2026-08-28..09-01. Dropped as already-published stories: CG Channel 'Adobe releases Photoshop 27.10' — same Adobe release (Instruct Edit with masks + AI Assisted Editor beta) already published 2026-08-28 via Animation World Network. Dropped as a within-pool duplicate: Creative Bloq 'Is Nvidia's DLSS 5 an AI slop machine...' — same DLSS 5 story as the 80 Level launch-date piece; kept the single strongest/newest article. Set aside for the outlet/category cap, not as duplicates: two extra Engineering.com CAD pieces (SunCubes simulation, plus DEVELOP3D Siemens Realize Live), three DEV Community AI-design first-person posts, UX Collective 'Making kyōwa possible with AI', Creative Bloq AI flyers, CIO DORA lifecycle, VentureBeat guardrails (no og_image), The Verge Gemini 3.8 Flash, LogRocket enterprise UX, Engadget Honor Robot Phone, and both YouTube social items. No selected URL appears in any published day.
